test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct about India for the period between 1950 and 1990?

options.text: The proportion of GDP contributed by agriculture and population engaged in the sector declined significantly.
The proportion of GDP contributed by agriculture declined significantly but not the population engaged in the sector.
Being an agricultural economy, the contribution of agricultural sector is not considerable for Indian economy
The proportion of GDP contributed by agriculture increased significantly but not the population engaged in the sector.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The proportion of GDP contributed by agriculture declined significantly between 1950 and 1990 in India.
 
• Despite the decline in the agricultural GDP contribution, the population engaged in the agricultural sector did not see a significant decline during the same period.
 
• The Indian economy was heavily reliant on agriculture post-independence but started diversifying into other sectors like industry and services over the decades.
 
• This period marked the beginning of structural transformation in the Indian economy, with a gradual shift from an agrarian-based economy to a more diversified economic structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **GDP (Gross Domestic Product)**

 
 
• Gross Domestic Product is the total value of all goods and services produced within a country in a specific period.
 
• It is a broad measure of overall domestic production and serves as a comprehensive scorecard of a given country's economic health.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Sector**
 
 
• The agricultural sector involves all the processes related to the cultivation of crops and raising livestock.
 
• Post-independence, India focused on agrarian reforms to achieve self-sufficiency in food grains production, leading to initiatives like the Green Revolution.
 
 
 
• **Structural Transformation**
 
 
• Structural transformation refers to the long-term shift in the fundamental composition of an economy.
 
• This usually involves a shift from a dominance of agriculture to industry and services.
 
• In India, the period between 1950 and 1990 was crucial for setting the stage for such transformation.
 
 
 
• **Population Engaged in Agriculture**
 
 
• This refers to the percentage of the workforce involved in agricultural activities.
 
• In developing countries like India, a significant portion of the population was historically engaged in agriculture, even as the economy started to diversify.
